origin.description: Build a UTF-8 string from integer Unicode code points.

arguments.name: vec
arguments.text: An integer vector, or a list of integer vectors.

origin.details: NULL is one missing string. An empty integer vector is an empty string. A code point of 0, a surrogate, NA, or a value outside 0x1..0x10FFFF warns and makes the whole string missing. The first invalid point is the one named in the warning.

translation.description: Build a UTF-8 string from integer Unicode code points.

arguments.name: vec
arguments.text: A list of integers, or a list of such lists. None inside that list is one missing string. An empty list is an empty list of vectors.

translation.details: None as the whole argument is one missing string. A code point of 0, a surrogate, NA, or a value outside 0x1..0x10FFFF warns and makes that string missing. A flat list is one vector. A list that contains a list or None is one vector per element.
translation.value: A string, NA, or a list of those.
translation.example:
from stringi.encoding import stri_enc_fromutf32
x = stri_enc_fromutf32([65, 261])
print(f"stri_enc_fromutf32([65, 261]) returns {x}.")
